payload.claim: All three new tests make the log fail on its very first append (the `Ceilings` event `run_task` emits before `run_one_cell` is even called) — via a directory occupying `events.jsonl` (lines 296-298, 331-333) or via `_FailFirst` failing exactly call #1 (lines 361-375). None constructs the scenario the spec is actually about: a log that writes several events successfully and only starts refusing partway through a long night. An implementation that only compares `log.failed` around the very first `emit` call (e.g. gated by a `first_call` flag) and never checks again afterward would pass all three tests unchanged, because in every one of them the flip from not-failed to failed happens on write #1. Such an implementation would silently miss the disk-fills-mid-run case this spec exists to surface, which the suite as written cannot catch.
